# Map runtime assets

- `us-atlas-3-states-10m.json`: pinned from [us-atlas 3.0.1](https://github.com/topojson/us-atlas/tree/v3.0.1), derived from U.S. Census Bureau cartography. SHA-256: `d76b391ccfa8bff601d51e3e3da5d43a89fa46cd5caca72ce731b383be5596d0`.
- `topojson-client-3.1.0.min.js`: pinned from [topojson-client 3.1.0](https://github.com/topojson/topojson-client/tree/v3.1.0), ISC licensed. SHA-256: `25cd02ae486cc5063e0215a4e4cfb15de83700c87ac48bac4d57dc6aaf3ebb89`.

These files are served locally so the map does not require jsDelivr after page load.
Their required ISC notices are retained in [LICENSES.md](LICENSES.md).
